RISK.TITLE: Before you start: understand the risks
RISK.DESCRIPTION:
WhatsApp does not like mass sending and can block your number. Mass sending is monitored and may lead to permanent ban.

WhatsApp prohibits automatic spam. If 2% of contacts report your message as SPAM, the number can be blocked.

Use varied/longer intervals, pauses, and smaller volumes to reduce risk — but no setting eliminates it. Many people prefer a separate number only for campaigns.
